nodes.label: No hardcoded hex in components
nodes.rationale: All UI colors come from CSS variables; exception is product filament colors (BOJE) because they are product data, not UI colors.

nodes.label: src/app/porudzbina/akcije.ts (order server action)
nodes.rationale: Re-validates everything and computes prices on the server so the client cannot tamper with prices.

nodes.label: Activity hidden pages -> useId instead of fixed id
nodes.rationale: Next keeps previous pages hidden in the DOM (Activity), so fixed ids would collide in repeated components.
nodes.norm_label: activity hidden pages -> useid instead of fixed id

nodes.label: Users: pet owners in Serbia and region, mobile from Instagram/TikTok
nodes.norm_label: users: pet owners in serbia and region, mobile from instagram/tiktok

nodes.label: Product Purpose (personalized pet gear + advice blog)
nodes.norm_label: product purpose (personalized pet gear + advice blog)

nodes.label: Positioning: pet gear with your pet's name, not faceless plastic
nodes.norm_label: positioning: pet gear with your pet's name, not faceless plastic

nodes.label: Conversion & proof (CTA, belief order, no fake reviews)
nodes.rationale: No reviews or customer photos exist yet; inventing reviews or counters is forbidden until real ones arrive.
nodes.norm_label: conversion & proof (cta, belief order, no fake reviews)

nodes.label: Anti-references (big chains, Temu-style, childish, generic templates)
nodes.norm_label: anti-references (big chains, temu-style, childish, generic templates)

nodes.label: Ime je heroj (name is the hero)
nodes.rationale: Pet's name on product is center of every key screen; live preview is the main visual.
nodes.norm_label: ime je heroj (name is the hero)

nodes.label: Bez pritiska (no pressure)
nodes.rationale: Trust built through honesty (price, production, delivery, COD), not urgency tricks.

nodes.label: Toplina kroz detalje, ne kroz dekoraciju
nodes.norm_label: toplina kroz detalje, ne kroz dekoraciju

nodes.label: Accessibility & Inclusion (WCAG 2.2 AA, 44px targets, color names)
nodes.rationale: Color choices always have a text name, not just a swatch, because of color blindness.
nodes.norm_label: accessibility & inclusion (wcag 2.2 aa, 44px targets, color names)

nodes.label: Osnovno (name, domain petzy.rs, slogan Za tvog najboljeg drugara)
nodes.norm_label: osnovno (name, domain petzy.rs, slogan za tvog najboljeg drugara)

nodes.label: Palette Suncano dvoriste
nodes.rationale: ~70% krem/belo, 20% teget, 10% koral; koral kept special, never for large areas.

nodes.label: Pravila citljivosti (WCAG contrast rules)
nodes.rationale: Koral on light is only 2.6:1, so links use tamni koral (4.9:1); CTA koral bg with teget bold >=18px text (4.4:1 valid only for large text).

nodes.label: Nunito typography
nodes.rationale: Rounded and warm; supports c/c/s/z/dj and Cyrillic; must load latin-ext,cyrillic subsets.

nodes.label: Logo (paw in koral circle + petzy wordmark)
nodes.norm_label: logo (paw in koral circle + petzy wordmark)

nodes.label: Oblici i vizuelni stil (rounded, soft shadows, sparing paw, photos)
nodes.norm_label: oblici i vizuelni stil (rounded, soft shadows, sparing paw, photos)

nodes.label: Ton komunikacije (neighbor with a dog and cat)
nodes.rationale: Address with 'ti', pet by name, no emoji in UI, no fake urgency, no unprovable health claims.
nodes.norm_label: ton komunikacije (neighbor with a dog and cat)
